summary: Refuse an advanced exchange success after its permission expires or changes

replay.detail: Envelope receipt, duplicate handling, projection and replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: No durable table, index or data-format changes; retry credit is private task-local state.

rules.detail: No claim or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Only the private advanced retry wrapper changes: after a successful exchange completes, recheck its current authority, routes, removal and monotonic expiry before reporting success. Ordinary exchanges and original errors, including signed overload, retain their existing behavior.

downtime.detail: No migration or additional service interruption beyond a normal binary swap.

manual.detail: No new configuration or manual action.

recovery.detail: A final receive, notification or empty checkpoint-need await cannot turn an invalidated advanced permission into a successful exchange and a fresh five-minute credit. Typed refusal preserves committed effects and does not create an adoption cooldown. One opportunity remains a full exchange with potentially multiple POSTs. Source-only draft; original recovery and performance qualification remain open.
